nodes.label: Lab Panel (simulation inspector)
nodes.rationale: Look inside the simulation: height, wetness, pigment amounts, every parameter

nodes.label: Wet Painting Save Format
nodes.rationale: Paintings save wet so the user can resume where they left off

nodes.label: Hand-tuned Pigment Spectra
nodes.rationale: Spectra tuned from each pigment's known look, not measured; mixes are plausible rather than exact

nodes.label: Kubelka-Munk Pigment Mixing
nodes.rationale: Colors mix like pigments, not light: each pigment is an absorption and scattering spectrum simulated on the GPU

nodes.label: Wet Paint GPU Simulation
nodes.rationale: Paint stays wet on the canvas; tools deposit, drag and mix existing paint

nodes.label: Blender Tool Icon (cadmium-blender-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 GNOME-style symbolic icon (#2e3436 single path): diagonal rounded handle from top-right, short ferrule, and a wide fan/spatula-shaped soft head at bottom-left — a blending brush for smudging paint.

nodes.label: Palette Knife Tool Icon (cadmium-knife-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 symbolic icon: diagonal handle, small neck/bolster, and a leaf/teardrop-shaped flat blade at bottom-left — a painter's palette knife.

nodes.label: Brush Tool Icon (cadmium-brush-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 symbolic icon: diagonal paintbrush with rounded handle, ferrule block, and a tapered pointed bristle tip toward bottom-left.

nodes.label: Rag Tool Icon (cadmium-rag-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 symbolic icon: irregular wavy-edged cloth with two cut-out fold/wrinkle lines — a rag for wiping or lifting paint.

nodes.label: Move Tool Icon (cadmium-move-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 symbolic icon: four-way cross of arrows pointing up, down, left and right — move/pan tool.

nodes.label: Paint Tube Icon (cadmium-tube-symbolic)
nodes.description: 16x16 symbolic icon: diagonal paint tube with crimped end bar at top-right, body with a label cut-out, tapered shoulder and small cap/nozzle at bottom-left — paint/colour source (likely colour picker or add-paint tool).
